items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: Billy Butler was one of the guitarists, and Milton Larkins and Carrie Smith and a very fine dancer.

ctx.x: Well, it was an old Apollo type sort of
situation, and Billy Butler was one of the guitarists, and Milton Larkins and Carrie Smith and a very fine dancer. I can't recall his name right this minute. I should. And --
